description: Manage analyzer configurations, generate AI tool configs, manage whitelists, and manage invariant rules. Actions: get, set, reset (analyzer configs), generate (AI tool config files), whitelist_list, whitelist_add, whitelist_update, whitelist_detect, rules_list, rules_check.

action.description: Action to perform. One of: get, set, reset, generate, whitelist_list, whitelist_add, whitelist_update, whitelist_detect, rules_list, rules_check.

analyzerName.description: Specific analyzer name, or omit to get all configs.

config.description: Configuration object for the analyzer (e.g., thresholds, rules).

configPath.description: Path to .codeauditor.json (defaults to auto-detect in current working tree).

description.description: Explanation of why this is whitelisted.

name.description: Class name or import path to whitelist.

path.description: Project path to analyze (defaults to current directory).

projectPath.description: Optional project path for project-specific config.

status.description: Filter by status: active, pending, rejected, disabled.

tools.description: AI tools to configure (claude, codex, cursor, gemini, copilot, continue, awsq, codeium, vscode, cline, zcode).

type.description: Filter by type: platform-api, framework-class, project-dep, shared-library, node-builtin.

name: config
